entries.title: Uso após move
entries.summary: String usada depois de ser movida. O checker rejeita o programa com E0301 antes de gerar código.
entries.diagnostics:
error[E0301]: use of moved value `first`
  --> string_move_invalid.isa:4:9
   |
  3 |   let second = first.move();
    |                ------------ ownership moved here
  4 |   print(first);
    |         ^^^^^ value used here after ownership was consumed
    = note: the original binding no longer owns this resource
    = help: use `second`, or borrow `first` instead of moving it
